Figuring out when to do your next Traversal after unlocking Zeus can be a little difficult.
Zeus offers a wide selection of Relics which are permanent upgrades that persist through TRs (Traversals). Therefor, it's recommened to stay in this Traversal for a long time.
Generally, if you do not have the Attraction Gem Quality 2 in the Ouroboros Gem Collection, this is worth a reset after having farmed for a day or two in Zeus (for relics).
If you already have Attraction 2, it's recommended to spend up towards 7-21 days (you be the judge!) pushing Zeus content and acquiring new Relics. This will supercharge your build-up in the next TR!

We've changed a lot of "Pre-Ouro" numbers which means you may feel stuck as you are no longer intended to push past e1000 MP until after having done your first Traversal (Ouroboros Ship Content).
Reaching the Ouroboros Prestige Layer is MUCH easier than the previous 1e1500 MP cost as it has now been reduced to e888.
This may feel a little weird for existing players or players in the middle/end of the "the burst" - but for new players this is a great change.
If you already have more than e888 MP, Find the Loop Mod that unlocks the Sekhur Campaign Missions in the Loop Mod Tree.

In your second run, your primary goal is to get to ~e155 MP, so that you can unlock your MK8 Generators.
This will re-apply any One Timer Diamond cards, and increase Cell Gained, which equals more personnel.
After that, there's some key goals to aim for while you farm Relics from Farm Missions & Campaigns. These are as follows:
- e169 MP to get the Epsilon Accumulator lv. 2
- e170 MP to get Rule of Persistence lv. 1
- e203 MP for Epsilon Accumulator lv. 3 + Persistence lv. 2
- e215 MP for Fenix Accumulator lv. 1
After the above, your MP gains will stall and there will be no major MP upgrades until e260 for Fenix lv. 2.
Due to that gap, make sure to focus a long run for Campaign Completions & Relic Fragment farming.
